why_this_commit: the last commit before OpenBB relicensed to AGPL-3.0 (c61d10d6, 2024-05-14); PyPI openbb-econdb 1.1.0-1.5.1 is AGPL-3.0-only and requires openbb-core<2
dropped: tests/ (VCR cassettes for pytest-recorder), poetry.lock, the nest_asyncio dependency
changes: openbb_econdb/__init__.py: each fetcher also under an econdb-only model key EconDb<Std>, which the routes use
pyproject.toml (new, hatchling): provider and core-extension entry points, openbb-core>=2.0.1
utils/helpers.py: no nest_asyncio (update_json_files uses asyncio.run); main_tickers.csv over https; missing values as None under pandas 3
models/economic_indicators.py: frequency None (openbb-core 2's standard parameter) means the default
utils/main_indicators.py: name the pivoted index (pandas 3 drops it)
